about: Zelda's lines (ours, plain text, no voice). talk: what she says when you talk to her, Link's choices and her replies. mood is kept for the date (stage 2); stage 1 plays anim only.
name: Zelda

talk.label: Talk00
talk.text: Link! You found the right door. The other two are... decorative. I read too many castle mystery books.

reply.label: Talk01
reply.text: That's sweet. And a little alarming, given the Moblin outside.

reply.label: Talk02
reply.text: Luck is just research nobody wrote down yet.

reply.label: Talk03
reply.text: Please don't open them. I haven't catalogued what's behind them.
